description: Data model, reporting state machine, matches/chat services, in-process pub/sub, and their tests. Moves result writing (setMatchResult/clearMatchResult/loadMatch) from services/stages.ts into a new services/matches.ts, makes refreshStage delete stale reports and help flags and return the ids of changed matches, and rewires the existing admin Matches actions to the matches service. No new UI. Plan items 1-7 in .agents/tasks/m6-match-room/plan.md (read the 'Design decisions' section there first; it is binding). FEAT-002 depends on this.
steps: Plan item 1 — scripts/migrate.js: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url' and use migrationsFolder: fileURLToPath(new URL('../drizzle', import.meta.url)). Run `$env:DATABASE_URL='postgres://root:mysecretpassword@localhost:5432/tournament_e2e'; node scripts/migrate.js` (expect 'Migrations applied').

Plan item 2 — src/lib/server/db/schema.ts: add matches.helpRequested (boolean 'help_requested' notNull default false); pgEnum reportSource 'report_source' ['participant','organizer','api_key']; table matchReports 'match_reports' (id, matchId->matches cascade, source, participantId->participants cascade nullable, userId->users set null nullable, apiKeyId->apiKeys set null nullable, entrants jsonb [string,string] notNull, scores jsonb [number,number] notNull, createdAt, updatedAt, unique(matchId, participantId)); table matchMessages 'match_messages' (id, matchId->matches cascade, authorId->users cascade notNull, asOrganizer boolean default false, body text notNull, createdAt, index(matchId, createdAt)); export types MatchReport, MatchMessage, ReportSource. Then `corepack pnpm db:generate --name match_room` (set $env:DATABASE_URL to the local db in the same call if drizzle-kit asks) and `corepack pnpm db:migrate`.

Plan item 3 — src/lib/matchReports.ts (pure, shared with UI): Scores, SideReport {side:0|1;scores}, sameScores, MatchProgress = MatchStatus | 'reported' | 'disputed', matchProgress(status, reports), ReportOutcome 'saved'|'agreed'|'disputed'|'closed', reportOutcome(reports, side, scores), matchQueue(items) (filter ready/reported/disputed; rank disputed 0, helpRequested 1, reported 2, ready 3; tiebreak stageIndex, groupIndex, number). Tests in src/lib/matchReports.spec.ts.

Plan item 4 — src/lib/server/events.ts: TournamentEvent ({type:'chat';matchId;message:ChatMessage} | {type:'matches';matchIds:string[]}), subscribe(tournamentId, listener) -> unsubscribe, publish(tournamentId, event), eventStream(tournamentId, signal, pick) -> Response (text/event-stream, cache-control no-cache, x-accel-buffering no; 'retry: 3000' first; 'event: <name>
data: <json>

'; ': ping' every 25s; idempotent stop on cancel/abort/enqueue error). Create src/lib/server/services/chat.ts with the exported ChatMessage interface now ({ id; body; createdAt: Date; asOrganizer: boolean; author: { username; displayName; avatarUrl: string | null } }). Tests in src/lib/server/events.spec.ts (vi.useFakeTimers for the ping).

Plan item 5 — src/lib/server/services/stages.ts: export lockStage; refreshStage returns Promise<string[]> ([] when the stage isn't running); inside the existing 'row differs' block compute stale = participant1Id/participant2Id changed || next.status not in ('ready','completed'); when stale delete that match's match_reports and set helpRequested false in the same update; collect and return changed ids. Remove loadMatch/setMatchResult/clearMatchResult from this file. After the transactions in startTournament and startNextStage call publish(tournament.id, { type: 'matches', matchIds: [] }).

Plan item 6 — src/lib/server/services/matches.ts: matchIdSchema = z.uuid('Match not found.'); scoresSchema (score1/score2: z.string('Enter both scores.').trim().regex(/^\d{1,9}$/, 'Scores must be whole numbers, zero or more.').transform(Number), object transformed to [n, n]); private loadMatch (join stage by tournament, 'Match not found.', lockStage, 'Results can only change while the stage is being played.', re-select the match row after locking), resultFor (integer/non-negative check + 'Elimination matches need a winner, so the scores must differ.'), applyResult (set result, helpRequested false, updatedAt; return [match.id, ...refreshStage ids]), playerReports (participant rows whose entrants equal the current entrants -> SideReport[]). Exports: type Override = { userId } | { apiKeyId }; setMatchResult(tournament, matchId, scores, by) (status ready|completed else "This match isn't ready to be played."; delete reports; insert one organizer/api_key report; applyResult); clearMatchResult(tournament, matchId); reportResult(tournament, matchId, userId, scores) -> 'saved'|'agreed'|'disputed' (messages: 'Results can only be reported while the tournament is running.', "This match can't be reported now.", 'Only the players of this match can report its result.', closed -> "The reports don't match, so an organizer will decide the result."; upsert own report via onConflictDoUpdate target [matchId, participantId]; agreed -> applyResult); requestHelp(tournament, matchId, userId) (running + ready + entrant, 'Only the players of this match can ask for help.'); clearHelp(tournament, matchId); interface MatchItem { id, number, stageIndex, stageCount, groupIndex, groupCount, side, entrants, result, status, progress, helpRequested, reports }; listMatches(bracket: Bracket) (2 queries by stage ids, matchNumbers per group, drop unnumbered byes, sort stage/group/number); getMatch(tournamentId, matchId) -> MatchItem & { stageType, stageStatus, decidedBy: 'organizer'|'api_key'|null } | undefined. All mutations publish { type: 'matches', matchIds: unique ids } AFTER the transaction. Then fill src/lib/server/services/chat.ts: messageSchema (trim, 1..1000, 'Write a message.' / 'Messages can be at most 1000 characters.'), listMessages(matchId) oldest first, postMessage(tournament, matchId, { userId, organizer }, body) ('Match not found.'; non-organizers must be an entrant: 'Only the players of this match and the organizers can write here.'; asOrganizer = organizer && !isPlayer; publish chat event).

Plan item 6 (callers) — src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/matches/+page.server.ts: import from #lib/server/services/matches.ts; `result` parses matchIdSchema + scoresSchema (fail(400, { error: issues[0].message })) and calls setMatchResult(tournament, id, scores, { userId: user.id }) (user from requireTournamentAdmin); `clear` parses the id and calls clearMatchResult. src/lib/server/services/tournaments.db.spec.ts: import setMatchResult/clearMatchResult from './matches', hoist `owner` to a module-level let, pass { userId: owner.id } everywhere (incl. playAll).

Plan item 7 — src/lib/server/services/matches.db.spec.ts covering: agree; edit before confirmation; conflict -> disputed (and further reports rejected); organizer override replaces reports (one organizer report, helpRequested cleared, getMatch decidedBy 'organizer') and clearMatchResult removes reports; permission and phase checks (wrong player, non-participant, elimination draw stores nothing, waiting final, completed match, completed tournament); stale reports after an upstream correction (pending final report and help removed when #1 is corrected, new entrant can report); help set/clear/cleared by agreement; queue order with SE of 8 (#1 disputed, #2 help, #3 one report, #4 none); chat permissions, asOrganizer marking and order; subscribe() receives matches and chat events.
Run `corepack pnpm format`, then the verification commands. Do not commit.

setMatchResult/clearMatchResult no longer exist in services/stages.ts; admin Matches result entry goes through services/matches.ts with Zod-validated input
No commit was made (git log still shows 98d079b at HEAD)

findings:

EXPORTS FOR FEAT-002 (match the plan unless noted):
- #lib/matchReports.ts: type Scores, interface SideReport { side: 0|1; scores }, sameScores(a,b), type MatchProgress, matchProgress(status, reports), type ReportOutcome, reportOutcome(reports, side, scores), matchQueue<T extends { progress; helpRequested; stageIndex; groupIndex; number }>(items): T[].
- #lib/server/events.ts: type TournamentEvent, subscribe(tournamentId, listener) -> () => void, publish(tournamentId, event), eventStream(tournamentId, signal: AbortSignal, pick: (e: TournamentEvent) => { event: string; data: unknown } | null): Response.
- #lib/server/services/matches.ts: matchIdSchema (z.uuid('Match not found.')); scoresSchema parses the raw form values: `scoresSchema.safeParse({ score1: form.get('score1'), score2: form.get('score2') })` -> Scores (null -> 'Enter both scores.', '' or non-digits -> 'Scores must be whole numbers, zero or more.'); type Override = { userId } | { apiKeyId }; setMatchResult(tournament, matchId, scores, by); clearMatchResult(tournament, matchId); reportResult(tournament, matchId, userId, scores): Promise<'saved'|'agreed'|'disputed'>; requestHelp(tournament, matchId, userId); clearHelp(tournament, matchId); interface MatchItem; listMatches(bracket: Bracket): Promise<MatchItem[]>; getMatch(tournamentId, matchId) -> (MatchItem & { stageType; stageStatus; decidedBy: 'organizer'|'api_key'|null }) | undefined.
- #lib/server/services/chat.ts: messageSchema, interface ChatMessage, listMessages(matchId): Promise<ChatMessage[]>, postMessage(tournament, matchId, { userId, organizer }, body): Promise<ChatMessage>.
- stages.ts: lockStage exported; refreshStage returns Promise<string[]>; getBracket/Bracket unchanged (admin load still imports getBracket from stages.ts).

NOTES / GOTCHAS:
- MatchItem.entrants is BracketMatch['entrants'] ([string|null|undefined, ...]); MatchItem.reports holds only participant reports made for the current entrants, sorted by side. Organizer/API-key reports only surface as getMatch().decidedBy (also checked against current entrants).
- requestHelp messages not fixed by the plan: tournament not running or match not ready -> 'Help can only be requested while the match is being played.'. It locks via loadMatch, so a non-running stage gives 'Results can only change while the stage is being played.' (unreachable from the UI when canHelp requires playing).
- clearHelp has no phase check; only 'Match not found.' for matches outside the tournament. It doesn't touch updatedAt.
- Published events: reportResult saved/disputed -> { type: 'matches', matchIds: [matchId] }; agreement/override/clear -> match id + refreshStage's changed ids (deduped); requestHelp/clearHelp -> [matchId]; startTournament/startNextStage -> matchIds []. postMessage publishes { type: 'chat', matchId, message } with createdAt as a Date (JSON over SSE turns it into a string; the room must rebuild the Date as the plan says).
- match_messages.as_organizer is NOT NULL DEFAULT false (plan just said default false).
- Queue db test is reversed vs the plan (#4 disputed, #3 help, #2 one report, #1 untouched -> order 4,3,2,1) so the order can't come from number sorting alone.
- events.spec.ts ping test uses vi.useFakeTimers() and restores real timers in afterEach.
